5.title: Undergraduate, Repeating A Course
5.chunk_text: Conditions of repeating a course is stated as below. Students who get an 'F', 'U', 'NA' or 'W' grade for University Courses offered in first year of education ; must take the subject course again in the following first semester it is given. Students who get an 'F', 'U', 'NA' or 'W' grade for elective or courses dropped from the curriculum, should take a substitute course approved by his/her advisor. For students who complete all courses offered in his/her diploma programs and other graduation requirements; this condition is not required. Students may repeat the courses in which they received passing grades ( (A, A-, B+, B, B-, C+,C, C-, D+, D) within 3 semesters at maximum following the semester they have taken it. The periods of semester leave and summer semester are not included in the semester counts. In the calculation of CGPA*, the previous point received for the repeated courses is replaced with the new point however all the registered courses of the student are shown in the transcript. * CGPA is calculated with SU credits.

27.title: Undergraduate, Dismissal from the University
27.chunk_text: In undergraduate education, the provisions regarding the termination of enrollment by the University are applied as follows, in accordance with the relevant regulations and decisions of the Higher Education Council: At the End of the Maximum Period of Study: The normal duration of undergraduate diploma programs is four academic years (eight semesters); the maximum duration of study is seven academic years (fourteen semesters), excluding the foundation year and optional summer terms. At the end of this maximum duration, including the examination and/or additional time rights granted under Article 44/c of Law No. 2547, students who fail to meet the graduation requirements will have their enrollment terminated by the University. At the End of the Not-Registration Period; a. 67.title: Application for Graduation
67.chunk_text: he graduation process at Sabancı University begins with the student's application. Students who are eligible to graduate must submit their graduation applications through the Information System within the dates specified in the academic calendar after enrolling in the semester. For the application to be valid, the student must successfully complete the courses they are enrolled in for that semester. Graduation applications are only valid for the semester in which they are submitted. If a student does not meet the graduation requirements by the end of the semester, they must reapply in the following term.

68.title: Graduation Requirements
68.chunk_text: In order to graduate from undergraduate programs, students applying for graduation must meet all the conditions specified in the Sabancı University Undergraduate Regulations. (Click here for the Sabancı University Undergraduate Regulations.) Students must have completed at least their last two semesters as full-time students at Sabancı University. The required SU credits and ECTS credits for graduation from the enrolled diploma program must be completed. (Graduation tracking should be done via the "Degree Evaluation" form in the Information System.) Both the Cumulative GPA (CGPA) and the Program GPA must be at least 2.00. Additionally, students who started their studies in the Foundations Development Year (FDY) must successfully complete the TLL 001 course. (As of the 2020-2021 Academic Year, the content of TLL 001 has been included in TLL 101 and TLL 102, which are offered at the undergraduate level, and will no longer be provided as a separate course. For students admitted before the 2020-2021 Academic Year, this requirement remains in effect, and the course will continue to be offered.) Important Notes Failed courses, as well as language courses for students in the Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences, are not included in the Degree Evaluation Form. However, while these courses are included in the Cumulative GPA (CGPA), they are not included in the Program GPA.

72.title: Diploma/Diploma Supplement
72.chunk_text: General Information: According to YÖK regulations, graduates of the Faculty of Engineering and Natural Sciences will have their title mentioned on their diplomas. 87.title: Foundation Development Year, Dismissal from the University
87.chunk_text: Students who have studied in the Foundation Development Year (FDY) for at least one academic year are considered unsuccessful in the following cases: Students who fail to submit a valid language exemption certificate on the dates determined by the University at the end of each semester while enrolled in FDY. Students who fail to meet the success requirements determined by the University for the final level that must be completed while enrolled in FDY. Students who fail to pass the English Language Assessment Exam (ELAE). Rights of Students Who Are Unsuccessful in FDY: After completing one academic year in FDY, students may either continue their FDY education for one or two additional semesters or apply for the "externally prepared student" status, where they continue improving their English language skills independently outside the university. Students who wish to continue for one or two additional semesters in FDY must submit a petition to the School of Languages Directorate within the dates announced by the University and pay the required tuition fees for the relevant semester. Based on the evaluation of the School of Languages Board, students are placed into an appropriate level. The period spent under the externally prepared student status is included in the total education period of FDY. These students can start their undergraduate programs if they pass the ELAE administered by the University or submit a valid language exemption certificate on the dates determined by the University. 97.title: Undergraduate, Withdraw From A Course
97.chunk_text: A- Application Requirements Course withdrawal process is only for undergraduate students. It can be done only for compulsory Fall and Spring terms, within the dates announced on Academic Calendar. Maximum 2 course withdrawals can be done in a semester; while it is maximum 6 in total throughout the entire education period. The course is graded with “W” if it is withdrawn. It is not included in the calculation of credit and grade point average. Withdrawn course can be repeated. If a course is repeated (including the courses graded with “W”), it is not possible to withdraw it. B- Application Steps: Students, who would like to withdraw from a course within the announced dates: Are required to apply through ”Information System / Student & Financial Aid / Registration / Request to Withdrawal Form” Applications are submitted to the approval of the course instructor online. Also, instructor receives an e-mail about each course withdrawal request, once it is submitted. Instructor may “approve” or “reject” the course withdrawal request through the online system. If the instructor approves course withdrawal request, system registration is created automatically to be processed; and, students can follow the process from the system. Application approved by the instructor is processed. Approved applications can be viewed on the transcript in the end of application process.
